design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQv uses 90th percentile rainfall depth 1.20 in (Ch. 7 example). Common SHWT separation is 2 ft (24 in); sole-source aquifer and some infiltration contexts require 4 ft (48 in). Rain gardens specify 12–18 in min filter media by variant; standard infiltration/filtration bioretention require 30 in min media. Infiltration feasibility threshold fc ≥ 0.50 in/hr; pond outlets detain WQv 24 hr (12 hr trout waters). Dry swale channel slope 0.50%–4.0% (single canonical slope value not specified).
